title: Petition and Application of the Salisbury Water Supply Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, §§ 14 and 17A, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities to issue and sell up to 7,000 shares of common stock, $100 par value, in the aggregate amount of $700,000 and to issue and sell $2,800,000 aggregate principal amount of its 7.71 percent Series General Mortgage Bonds due June 1, 2023.
